title: Pistachio & White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Mix pistachio cream and almond flour until a soft dough forms.
Divide into equal balls and chill for 1 hour.
Melt white chocolate with coconut oil.
Dip each ball in the chocolate and sprinkle with pistachios.
Chill for 30–60 minutes until set.

title: Biscoff Cheesecake Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the biscuits very finely.
Mix with cream cheese and Biscoff spread.
Divide into equal balls and chill for 45 minutes.
Melt the white chocolate and dip the balls.
Sprinkle with biscuit crumbs and chill until firm.

title: Oreo & White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the whole Oreos, including filling, into fine crumbs.
Mix with cream cheese and vanilla.
Roll into balls and freeze for 25–30 minutes.
Melt white chocolate with coconut oil.
Dip the truffles and chill until the coating is firm.

title: Raffaello-Style Coconut & Almond Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat the cream until just steaming and pour over chopped white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in the filling coconut and vanilla.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Wrap a portion around each almond and roll into a ball.
Roll in coconut and chill until firm.

title: Dark Chocolate Hazelnut Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Cocoa powder or extra chopped hazelnuts, for coating
steps: Heat cream until just boiling and pour over chopped chocolate.
Leave for 2 minutes, then stir until glossy.
Stir in vanilla and chopped hazelnuts.
Chill until firm, then roll into balls.
Coat in cocoa or hazelnuts and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Cheesecake Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the biscuits finely.
Mix with cream cheese, icing sugar, lemon zest and juice.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Melt white chocolate and dip each truffle.
Chill until set. Add a little extra lemon zest on top if desired.

title: Salted Caramel Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Thick dulce de leche or caramel
steps: Heat cream and pour over the milk chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in caramel and sea salt.
Chill until firm enough to roll.
Form into balls and freeze for 20 minutes.
Dip in melted dark chocolate and finish with a tiny pinch of sea salt.

title: Tiramisu Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the ladyfingers finely.
Mix with mascarpone, espresso, icing sugar and vanilla.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll into balls.
Coat generously in cocoa and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Mix peanut butter, icing sugar, biscuit crumbs and vanilla.
Roll into balls and chill for 45 minutes.
Melt chocolate with coconut oil.
Dip each truffle in chocolate.
Refrigerate until the shell is firm.

title: Espresso Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with espresso powder until steaming.
Pour over chopped dark chocolate and leave for 2 minutes.
Add butter and vanilla, then stir until smooth and glossy.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat with cocoa.
Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Strawberry White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Grind the freeze-dried strawberries to a fine powder.
Heat the cream until steaming and pour over the filling white chocolate. Leave 2 minutes, then stir smooth.
Mix in strawberry powder, vanilla and salt. Chill for about 3 hours until firm.
Roll into balls and freeze for 15 minutes.
Melt the coating chocolate with optional coconut oil, dip the truffles and top with crushed strawberry. Chill until set.

title: Raspberry White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Extra freeze-dried raspberries, crushed, for topping
steps: Grind the raspberries to powder and sift out the seeds.
Heat the cream, then add the filling white chocolate and coconut oil. Stir until smooth.
Mix in the raspberry powder and chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls and chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the coating chocolate, dip each truffle and sprinkle with crushed raspberries. Chill until set.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the biscuits finely.
Mix with cream cheese, icing sugar, strawberry powder and vanilla.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Melt white chocolate with coconut oil and dip each truffle.
Sprinkle with crushed strawberries and chill until firm.

title: Raspberry Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Grind and sift the freeze-dried raspberries.
Heat the cream until steaming and pour over the white chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in raspberry powder, vanilla and salt, then chill until firm.
Roll into balls and chill for 30 minutes.
Dip in melted dark chocolate, dust with raspberry powder and chill until set.

title: Passion Fruit & White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream and passion fruit until steaming.
Pour over chopped white chocolate and leave for 1 minute.
Stir smooth, add butter and chill until firm.
Roll into balls and freeze for 20 minutes.
Dip in melted white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Matcha & Coconut Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Extra coconut or matcha, for coating
steps: Heat coconut cream until steaming.
Pour over white chocolate, then whisk in matcha.
Stir in coconut and chill until firm.
Roll into balls.
Coat in coconut or a light dusting of matcha.

title: Earl Grey Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with the tea bags and steep for 8–10 minutes.
Remove tea bags, reheat the cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Chai Milk Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with all spices until steaming.
Pour over milk chocolate and stir smooth.
Chill until firm and roll into balls.
Dip in dark chocolate and chill until set.

title: Orange & Ginger Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Cocoa powder or finely chopped candied ginger, for coating
steps: Heat cream with orange zest and ginger.
Pour over chopped chocolate and leave for 2 minutes.
Stir in butter until glossy.
Chill, roll into balls and coat.

title: Mango & Coconut White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat coconut cream until steaming and pour over white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in mango powder and coconut.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls and coat in coconut.

title: Blueberry & Lemon Cheesecake Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush biscuits very finely.
Mix with cream cheese, sugar, blueberry powder and lemon zest.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Dip in melted white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Cherry & Almond Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in cherry powder and almond extract.
Chill until firm and roll into balls.
Coat in chopped toasted almonds.

title: Banana Peanut Butter Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Mix peanut butter, biscuit crumbs, banana powder and icing sugar.
Roll into balls and chill for 45 minutes.
Dip in melted milk chocolate.
Chill until firm.

title: Coffee & Cardamom Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with espresso and cardamom until steaming.
Pour over chocolate and leave for 2 minutes.
Stir in butter until smooth.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Key Lime Pie Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Finely crushed digestive biscuits, for coating
steps: Heat cream, condensed milk and lime zest until steaming; leave 10 minutes.
Reheat and pour over white chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in lime juice and butter, then chill until firm.
Roll into balls and coat in biscuit crumbs.
Chill until set.

title: Crème Brûlée White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with vanilla until steaming and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter and flaky salt, then chill until firm.
Roll into balls and refrigerate.
Melt the caster sugar in a dry pan until amber, pour onto baking paper and cool completely.
Crush the caramel into fine shards and roll the truffles in them just before serving.

title: Black Forest Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream and pour over dark chocolate. Leave 2 minutes, then stir smooth.
Mix in cherries and optional kirsch.
Chill until firm, then roll into balls.
Dip in melted dark chocolate and top with a little chopped cherry.
Chill until set.

title: Apple Pie Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the biscuits finely.
Mix with cream cheese, icing sugar, apple powder and spices.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Dip in melted white chocolate.
Dust lightly with cinnamon and chill until firm.

title: Pistachio Tiramisu Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Cocoa powder and finely chopped pistachios, for coating
steps: Mix ladyfinger crumbs, mascarpone, pistachio cream, espresso and icing sugar.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll into balls.
Coat half in cocoa and half in chopped pistachios, or mix the two coatings.
Refrigerate until firm.

title: Raspberry & Rose White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream until steaming and pour over white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in raspberry powder and rose water.
Chill until firm and roll into balls.
Dip in white chocolate and top with raspberry pieces.
Chill until set.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush the biscuits finely.
Mix with cream cheese, icing sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice and poppy seeds.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Dip in melted white chocolate.
Sprinkle with a few poppy seeds and chill until set.

title: Cinnamon Bun Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Crush biscuits very finely.
Mix with cream cheese, brown sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.
Roll into balls and chill for 1 hour.
Dip in white chocolate.
Finish with a very light dusting of cinnamon.

title: Coconut Passion Fruit Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat coconut cream and passion fruit until steaming.
Pour over white chocolate and stir smooth.
Mix in desiccated coconut and chill until firm.
Roll into balls.
Coat in coconut and refrigerate until set.

title: Dark Chocolate Chilli Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Ancho chilli powder or mild chilli powder
steps: Heat cream with chilli, cinnamon and salt until steaming.
Pour over dark chocolate and leave for 2 minutes.
Stir until smooth and chill until firm.
Roll into balls.
Coat in cocoa powder and refrigerate.

title: Yuzu & Black Sesame Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream until steaming and pour over the white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in yuzu and black sesame paste.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls, dip in white chocolate and sprinkle with black sesame.
Chill until set.

title: Strawberry Balsamic Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Cocoa powder or crushed freeze-dried strawberries, for coating
steps: Heat cream and pour over chopped dark chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in strawberry powder, balsamic and butter.
Chill until firm.
Roll into balls and coat in cocoa or strawberry crumbs.

title: Rosemary & Olive Oil Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with rosemary and steep 10 minutes.
Remove rosemary, reheat cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth, then whisk in olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Shiso & Lime White Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with shiso and lime zest, then steep 8 minutes.
Strain over white chocolate and stir smooth.
Mix in lime juice and chill until firm.
Roll into balls, dip in white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Black Sesame & Shoyu Caramel Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Toasted black sesame seeds, for topping
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in caramel, black sesame paste and soy sauce.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls, dip in dark chocolate and top with sesame.

title: Apricot & Hazelnut Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in apricots, hazelnuts and vanilla.
Chill until firm.
Roll into balls and coat in chopped hazelnuts.

title: Grapefruit & Tarragon Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with grapefruit zest and tarragon, then steep 8 minutes.
Strain and pour over chopped chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Pineapple & Cashew Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
ingredients: Extra coconut or cashews, for coating
steps: Heat coconut cream and pour over white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in pineapple powder, cashews and coconut.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls and coat in coconut or chopped cashews.

title: Sesame, Shichimi & Orange Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with orange zest and sesame.
Pour over chocolate and leave 2 minutes.
Stir smooth with butter and shichimi.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and finish with a tiny pinch of shichimi.

title: Honey Yuzu Truffles
desc: No-bake truffles with a chilled filling.
steps: Heat cream with honey until steaming.
Pour over white chocolate and stir smooth.
Mix in yuzu and butter, then chill until firm.
Roll into balls, dip in white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Irish Whiskey Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream until steaming and pour over chopped chocolate.
Leave 2 minutes, then stir until smooth.
Stir in butter and whiskey.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Bourbon & Salted Caramel Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
ingredients: Thick caramel or dulce de leche
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in caramel, bourbon and salt.
Chill until firm enough to roll.
Form into balls, chill again, then dip in dark chocolate.
Finish with a tiny pinch of sea salt.

title: Scotch Whisky & Espresso Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with espresso until steaming.
Pour over chocolate and leave 2 minutes.
Stir smooth, then add butter and whisky.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Dark Rum & Vanilla Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
ingredients: Cocoa powder or chocolate sprinkles, for coating
steps: Heat cream and pour over chopped chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter and vanilla.
Stir in rum once the ganache has cooled slightly.
Chill until firm, roll and coat.

title: Spiced Rum & Coconut Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with cinnamon and pour over chocolate.
Stir until smooth, then mix in rum and coconut.
Chill until firm.
Roll into balls and coat in coconut.

title: Coconut Rum White Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat coconut cream until steaming and pour over white chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in coconut rum and coconut.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls and coat in coconut.

title: Irish Cream Milk Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
ingredients: Milk or dark chocolate, for coating
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Stir in Irish cream liqueur.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and dip in chocolate.

title: Coffee Liqueur Espresso Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with espresso powder.
Pour over chocolate and stir smooth.
Mix in butter and coffee liqueur.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Amaretto & Almond Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth, then add amaretto and almond extract.
Chill until firm.
Roll into balls and coat in toasted almonds.

title: Grand Marnier Orange Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with orange zest and leave to infuse for 5 minutes.
Reheat and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter, then add orange liqueur.
Chill, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Cointreau White Chocolate & Orange Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with orange zest until steaming.
Pour over white chocolate and stir smooth.
Mix in Cointreau and chill until firm.
Roll into balls, dip in white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Frangelico Hazelnut Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate.
Stir smooth and add hazelnut liqueur.
Mix in half the hazelnuts and chill until firm.
Roll into balls, dip in dark chocolate and top with remaining hazelnuts.

title: Limoncello White Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with lemon zest and pour over white chocolate.
Stir until smooth.
Stir in limoncello and chill until firm.
Roll into balls, dip in white chocolate and chill until set.

title: Chambord Raspberry Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
ingredients: Cocoa or crushed freeze-dried raspberries, for coating
steps: Heat cream and pour over dark chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Mix in raspberry liqueur and raspberry powder.
Chill until firm, roll and coat.

title: Cherry Liqueur Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth, then mix in cherry liqueur and chopped cherries.
Chill until firm and roll into balls.
Dip in dark chocolate and chill until set.

title: Port & Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Add port and mix thoroughly.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Port, Fig & Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over dark chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter.
Mix in port and chopped figs.
Chill until firm, roll and coat in cocoa.

title: Red Wine & Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Simmer wine with sugar until reduced to about 30 ml; cool slightly.
Heat cream and pour over chocolate. Stir smooth with butter.
Mix in the wine reduction.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Prosecco & Strawberry White Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Simmer Prosecco until reduced to about 30 ml and let cool slightly.
Heat cream and pour over white chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in the Prosecco reduction and strawberry powder.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and dip in white chocolate.

title: Champagne White Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Reduce the sparkling wine to about 30 ml over medium heat and cool slightly.
Heat cream and pour over white chocolate.
Stir smooth with butter, then mix in the wine reduction.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and dip in white chocolate.

title: Marsala Tiramisu Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Mix biscuit crumbs, mascarpone, espresso, Marsala and icing sugar.
Chill for 30–45 minutes.
Roll into balls.
Coat generously in cocoa and refrigerate until firm.

title: Rum & Raisin Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Soak raisins in rum for 20–30 minutes.
Heat cream and pour over chocolate. Stir smooth with butter.
Mix in the rum-soaked raisins and any remaining rum.
Chill until firm, roll and coat in cocoa.

title: Whiskey & Orange Dark Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream with orange zest and steep for 5 minutes.
Pour over chocolate and stir smooth with butter.
Mix in whiskey.
Chill until firm, roll into balls and coat in cocoa.

title: Rum & Salted Caramel Milk Chocolate Truffles
desc: Boozy ganache truffles with a smooth alcoholic kick.
steps: Heat cream and pour over milk chocolate. Stir smooth.
Mix in caramel, rum and salt.
Chill until firm enough to shape.
Roll into balls, dip in dark chocolate and chill until set.
